_: Committed paths that exist on one developer's machine only. The set may only shrink: tests/test_portability.py refuses a new entry and refuses a stale one. Every entry here is a fallback or a detector's own pattern -- nothing in this list is a path the engine requires to run, which is the property that has to stay true.

/Users/.reason: the detector's own pattern: release_readiness scans a bundle for host paths, and this is one of the strings it looks for

/opt/homebrew/bin/codex.reason: guarded by Path.exists() and falls back to bare `codex` on PATH, so the literal is a Mac shortcut and never a requirement

~/Zotero/zotero.sqlite.reason: Zotero's own documented default location; the caller passes db_path on any host that differs

~/code/research-harness.reason: last candidate in a search that starts from this file's own parents, so it is only reached in a layout the package was not installed from

~/code/research-harness/.research-harnes.reason: legacy location for checkouts upgraded from the pre-OSS layout, searched after the package-relative one

~/code/rh-workspace.reason: last resort of find_workspace_root, guarded by exists(); returns None on a host without it rather than failing
